audio_caption: The clip begins with the sound of an engine. A male speaker welcomes viewers to "Sailing Ruby Rose," noting that they are getting close to the "pointy end" of the boat, discussing the upholstery and carpentry. He sounds enthusiastic and grateful to viewers for following the project over the years. The engine sound continues in the background while he speaks. Finally, acoustic guitar music begins to play. The music is gentle and calming, creating a relaxing atmosphere.

The clip begins with a male speaker explaining how they are starting the day underneath a boat. He says that at some point, he will be "scraping the hull," but first he wants to show things that are not escape hatches but "break glass in case of emergency." He sounds casual and informative. He says he wants to show the viewer "a lot of things going on underneath here," before moving to the interior. There is a pause and then he makes an "oh" sound.

The audio clip begins with a male speaker detailing the location under "portside hull number one," revealing a lightning protection system. He mentions an experience from past episodes, followed by his intention to show the boat, detailing that he will provide his first-hand reactions while stepping onboard. He mentions being told to take off his shoes, presumably so as not to "sully anything." He makes a lighthearted joke about his sandals. In the background, indistinguishable ambient sounds are present. The speaker then notes the presence of same-sized shoes and struggles to differentiate them.

A male speaker begins the audio, speaking in an informative tone. He says "I'm gonna go through things that I picked up on. Things that are super important: fire port." He describes what an engine fire port is on a boat, and its purpose: to avoid "feeding the fire" in the case of an engine fire. He explains how to use the fire port with a fire extinguisher. He summarizes that "that's good." Exterior plugs are briefly mentioned next by the same speaker. Sounds of the sea and a boat engine are present throughout the audio.

The clip starts with a male speaker discussing a "shore power connection" and then describes features of the boat, noting the "dinghy," the "tender of one," and its placement in the cockpit, mentioning how it looks with the davits in place. He anticipates it being a "fine, fine boat."  Next, he discusses the "trifoil or," the steering, and a "helm speed mechanism." He talks about the possibility of sitting there and enjoying a barbecue while looking back at the world, mentioning it's "pretty chill."  The clip ends with the speaker noting the wake behind and the benefit of seeing where you are going, and emphasizing having "one of each." The background contains consistent sounds of water, suggesting the recording took place on or near the water.

The audio clip begins with a male speaker referencing "catamaran reviews in 2019" and asks, "What does a bench seat mean for us?". He then explains the benefits of the bench seat, including having a footrest, being wider for two, and being comfortable on passage, and having good visibility. He excitedly claims, "This gives us all of that." After that, the speaker transitions, saying, "And now, I want to take you inside" while moving and then says "Here we are." Throughout the clip, there's the consistent background sound of water lapping and general boat sounds, establishing a setting on a boat.

The audio clip begins with a male speaker stating, "Here we are," followed by comments about someone being in a meeting. He humorously expresses his intent to move items around, asking viewers not to tell James. Another male voice proceeds to describe the galley and kitchen area on the boat, apologizing to James while continuing to provide details of the galley. The speaker highlights cabinetry and features, such as the tap or faucet. He continues providing details of features, such as window locations. The speaker makes a comment about talking to the skipper. He expresses admiration of the size and airiness. Transitioning to the chart table, followed by mentioning the upholstery. The speaker comments on the comfort and possibility of sleeping in the area. He expresses appreciation. He notices someone's presence. The speaker wonders what an individual thinks of him laying on the sofa and talking at the ceiling. The speaker addresses a "Mr. Kahn". He suggests he will explain everything later, reinforcing that the area is nice. Background ambient sounds and muffled noise are heard throughout the recording.

The audio clip begins with one male speaker expressing his desire to relax on a sofa, finding the experience surreal. He then speaks about clouds and zephyrs before mentioning work and light switches. Noting the appeal of the light switches, he praises the design and the sweeping features. The speaker describes the covering of these elements with a grey frosted panel and the presence of opening windows. He expresses overall satisfaction, highlighting the quality and epic nature of the craftsmanship. He then emphasizes the amazing nature of the carpentry, considering it the nicest woodwork he's ever seen on a boat, dismissing other works. The speaker continues with a walking tour, mentioning the walk-in wardrobe and apologizing for its initial darkness. He explains using a light to illuminate it, showcasing the wardrobe designs and plans for installation. He notes that the walk-in wardrobe's intended appearance is now visible thanks to the added light, describing how it’s meant to look.

A male speaker begins with a friendly tone, referencing catamaran reviews from 2019 and emphasizing the importance of joinery in assessing boat quality, issuing a challenge to showcase joinery in boats. The speaker mentions that the joinery being examined reminds him of old English boat designs done in high-quality teak, stating the exquisite X5 and Discovery catamaran had the best joinery, but claims the joinery here is better. The speaker encourages viewers considering catamarans, to visit boat shows, to examine and post pictures of boat joinery. The speaker notes that the project is nearing completion in 3 weeks, while expressing excitement and gratitude. Finally, promising to return next week. As the speaker says goodbye, a soft piano melody begins playing with a relaxing mood. In the background, there are consistent ambient sounds of wind and boat waves, alongside boat motor sounds that persist throughout the clip, providing a sense of constant motion and activity, suggesting the scene is aboard a moving boat.
